title: Goku Yelling (Power Up)
blurb: Twenty seconds of sustained effort before anything actually happens: commitment as content. Dragon Ball Z turned the power-up scream into an entire genre convention — the ground cracks, the hair changes colour, and an episode passes — and this is the purest example of the form. It is genuinely funny applied to ordinary tasks that require more will than they should. Play it while opening a jar, waiting for a download to reach ninety-nine per cent, or summoning the resolve to answer an email from a fortnight ago. The power level is rising, eventually.
origin: Goku's iconic power-up scream from Dragon Ball Z.
